note: Official counting stats. Pitch tracking is not published at this level, so the Statcast and model columns are not on this page.

metrics.label: IP
metrics.desc: Innings pitched (outs / 3; shown as decimal innings).

metrics.label: uBB
metrics.desc: Unintentional walks (MLB's BB includes IBB: add the IBB column).

metrics.label: R (on the mound)
metrics.desc: Runs scored while the pitcher was on the mound: inherited runners are not reassigned to the pitcher who put them on, and these are not earned runs.

metrics.label: FIP
metrics.desc: Fielding-independent pitching on the RA9 scale.
